QF.id: III-C Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices_16

question.text: The maximum penalty imposable under Section 15HA of the SEBI Act for fraudulent and unfair trade practices is:

answer.text: Three times the amount of profit or Rs. 25 crore, whichever is higher
Rs. 25 crore or twice the profit, whichever is higher
Rs. 10 crore or the amount of profit, whichever is higher

explanation.text: The Logic: As per Section 15HA (discussed in Case 8.3), the penalty for fraudulent and unfair trade practices may extend to Rs. 25 crore or three times the amount of profit made out of such practices, whichever is higher. The Trap: Rs. 25 crore is not the minimum -- the source statutory penalty table gives Rs. 5 lakh as the minimum. Rs. 25 crore is the monetary limb of the maximum formula and can itself be exceeded when three times the profit is higher. Note: Remember the structure: minimum Rs. 5 lakh; maximum is the higher of Rs. 25 crore or three times the profits made from the violation.
